revision="85d0691533f9d94ce83528a1c6edc0e82069f1d6"
patch_revision="network-profiles-v1"
installed_revision="$revision:$patch_revision"
checksum="ee42481ce500f0e153a6a11c150aae02b0d15f0b63b202db35b99c70edca694a"
destination="/plugins/user-creatable-servers"

if [ -f "$destination/.source-revision" ] && [ "$(cat "$destination/.source-revision")" = "$installed_revision" ]; then
  echo "User Creatable Servers is already pinned to $installed_revision"
  exit 0
fi

workdir="$(mktemp -d)"
archive="$workdir/plugins.tar.gz"
staging="/plugins/.user-creatable-servers.new"
trap 'rm -rf "$workdir" "$staging"' EXIT

wget -q -O "$archive" "https://github.com/pelican-dev/plugins/archive/$revision.tar.gz"
echo "$checksum  $archive" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$workdir"

rm -rf "$staging"
cp -R "$workdir/plugins-$revision/user-creatable-servers" "$staging"

# Upstream 1.1.1 overrides protected egg variables during
# self-service creation. Keep Pelican's user_editable guard.
sed -i 's/->disabled(false),/->disabled(fn (Get $get) => !$get("user_editable")),/' \
  "$staging/src/Filament/App/Pages/CreateServerPage.php"
if grep -Fq -- '->disabled(false)' "$staging/src/Filament/App/Pages/CreateServerPage.php" || \
  ! grep -Fq -- '->disabled(fn (Get $get) => !$get("user_editable")),' \
    "$staging/src/Filament/App/Pages/CreateServerPage.php"; then
  echo "Protected-variable patch did not apply" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cp /provisioning/UserResourceLimits.php "$staging/src/Models/UserResourceLimits.php"
cp /provisioning/user-creatable-servers.php "$staging/config/user-creatable-servers.php"
cmp -s /provisioning/UserResourceLimits.php "$staging/src/Models/UserResourceLimits.php"
cmp -s /provisioning/user-creatable-servers.php "$staging/config/user-creatable-servers.php"

printf '%s\n' "$installed_revision" > "$staging/.source-revision"
rm -rf "$destination"
mv "$staging" "$destination"
echo "Installed pinned User Creatable Servers source $installed_revision"

php artisan p:plugin:install user-creatable-servers

plugin_file="/var/www/html/plugins/user-creatable-servers/plugin.json"
if ! grep -Fq '"status": "enabled"' "$plugin_file"; then
  echo "User Creatable Servers did not become enabled" >&2
  exit 1
fi

php artisan tinker --execute="if (!Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\Schema::hasTable('user_resource_limits')) { throw new RuntimeException('User Creatable Servers migration is missing'); }"
php artisan p:plugin:list

set -eu
if [ ! -s /auth/codex_auth.json ]; then
  cp /bootstrap/auth.json /auth/codex_auth.json
  chmod 0600 /auth/codex_auth.json
fi

until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags | grep -q 'qwen3-embedding:0.6b'; do sleep 2; done
exec openviking-entrypoint

until OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434 ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done
OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434 ollama pull qwen3-embedding:0.6b

bind_address="0.0.0.0"
listen_port=8080
worker_threads=1 # or auto
redact_ip_addresses=true
result_image_theme="dark"
database_type="none"

#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "Starting OpenList as user $(id -u):$(id -g)..."

# Set umask if specified
if [ -n "$UMASK" ]; then
  umask "$UMASK"
fi

# Handle version command
if [ "$1" = "version" ]; then
  exec ./openlist version
fi

# Start aria2 if enabled
if [ "$RUN_ARIA2" = "true" ]; then
  echo "Starting aria2c in background..."
  aria2c \
    --enable-rpc \
    --rpc-allow-origin-all \
    --conf-path=/opt/aria2/.aria2/aria2.conf \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi

# Start OpenList server
echo "Starting OpenList server..."
exec ./openlist server --no-prefix

until mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "SELECT 1;" ; do
  echo "Waiting for MariaDB..."
  sleep 2
done
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`seafile_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`ccnet_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`seahub_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '$INIT_DB_PASSWORD';"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`seafile_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`ccnet_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`seahub_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

# 切换external时取消注释
# url: https://{{ .Release.Name }}.${MAIN_DOMAIN}/api2/ping/

# 初始化指标文件
touch /tmp/metrics.txt

# 后台进程：定期更新指标
while true; do
  {
    echo "# HELP smb_mount_healthy SMB 挂载点是否健康 (1=健康, 0=不健康)"
    echo "# TYPE smb_mount_healthy gauge"

    for mount_info in \
      "sakamoto_media:/mnt/sakamoto-media" \
      "backup_media:/mnt/backup-media"
    do
      name="$${mount_info%%:*}"
      path="$${mount_info#*:}"

      if timeout 5 ls "$path" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 1"
      else
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 0"
      fi
    done
  } > /tmp/metrics.txt.new && mv /tmp/metrics.txt.new /tmp/metrics.txt

  sleep 30
done &

# HTTP 服务器提供指标 (前台运行 httpd)
httpd -f -p 9101 -h /tmp
